scripts.text:
[Meow]
What...?! You forgot the
awesome skill I taught you?
Transcending's no excuse
for forgetting! Alright, so you
want me to teach you, eh?
Alright, here's your lesson!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
什么？！把我教你的绝招忘了？
转生可不是借口！
好，想让我再教一次是吧？
这就给你上一课！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*BAM! BOOM! CRASH!*^000000

[Meow]
Don't you dare get
hoity-toity with me, just
because you've been reborn!
You better remember how to
do that skill before I give
you another whupping!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
别以为转生了，就敢跟我摆架子！
最好赶在我再揍你一顿之前，把那招想起来！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou miraculously recall
the Sight Blaster skill before
Meow can administer another
vicious beating to you.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你赶在喵再次痛下狠手前，奇迹般地想起了火狩芽。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Remember now?
Great. Now I'm going
back to taking a nap.
If you even think about
bothering me, I'll make
you regret it. Mark my word!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
想起来了？
很好，我继续睡了。
你敢再来烦我，保准让你后悔，说到做到！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Zzz... Zzz...
Catherine... I'll
make you sorry for
turning me into a kitty...
I'm gonna... Gonna... Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
Zzz... Zzz...
凯瑟琳...我要让你为把我变成小猫而后悔...
我要...我要...Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
*Yaaawn~*
So sleeepy...
Hm? Did you want
to talk to me? Don't
bother me if you've
got nothing to say!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
*Yaaawn~*好困...
嗯？找我说话？
没事别烦我！

scripts.text: A cat?
scripts.translation: 猫？

scripts.text: Now I'm sleepy, too...
scripts.translation: 我也困了...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Yeah. Yeah, I'm a cat.
For now, anyway. Damn that
Catherine! She turned me into
this form when I borrowed some
gemstones without her consent.
I was gonna tell her!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
对对，我是猫，至少现在是。
都怪那凯瑟琳！
不过是没打招呼，借了她一点宝石，就把我变成这样。
我本来就要告诉她的！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Once I become human
again and regain my powers,
I'm gonna go freakin' buck
wild. Catherine, you, everyone.
You're all turning into cats!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
等我变回人，恢复力量，就要闹个天翻地覆！
凯瑟琳、你、所有人，统统给我变成猫！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Hah! Yeah...
Taking a nap sounds like
the best idea I've hear--oh.
Wait. You're a Wizard, right?
I was so sleepy, I didn't even
notice. Ah, this is good~
scripts.translation:
[喵]
哈，是啊...睡一觉，这主意再好不——哦。
等等，你是巫师吧？
太困了，都没注意。
嘿，这下好办了~

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Now, I'm supposed to be
teaching Wizards this new
skill on behalf of the Wizard
Guild. Although I don't really
want to, I pretty much don't have a choice. So what do you say?
scripts.translation:
[喵]
公会让我负责教巫师们这项新技能。
虽说我不乐意，可也没得选。
怎么样，学不学？

scripts.text: Nah, I'm too sleepy...
scripts.translation: 不了，我太困了...

scripts.text: Sure, I'd like to learn a new skill.
scripts.translation: 好啊，我想学个新技能

scripts.text:
[Meow]
^333333*Yaaaawn*^000000
Alright. If you wanna
learn it later, then come
back and remind me about
the skill. Well then, back to
napping... Zzz... Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
^333333*Yaaaawn*^000000
行，以后想学了就回来提醒我。
先接着睡...Zzz... Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Really? Fine, fine.
Just so you know, I'm
only teaching this skill so
that Catherine will return me
to my human form. It's too
humiliating to just be a cat!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
真的？行吧。
先说清楚，我教这招，只为让凯瑟琳把我变回人。
当只猫，实在太丢脸了！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Wait, now that I think
about it, that dog Maria has
been hanging about Catherine
for the longest time, but she's
never regained her human form.
N-no! I can't lose hope now!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
等等，玛丽亚那条狗跟着凯瑟琳那么久，也没变回人啊。
不、不行！现在可不能灰心！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Oh, let's just get this over
with. Now, you're aware that we
Wizards have great long range
attack skills, but we're weak
in short range battles, right?
scripts.translation:
[喵]
好了，赶紧教完算了。
巫师远攻厉害，近战却不行，这你知道吧？

scripts.text:
[Meow]
This new skill that I am
going to teach you has been
designed to compensate the
Wizard class's weakness in
close range combat. First,
you chant the spell...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
这项新技能，就是为了弥补巫师近战的短处。
先念咒...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Then, for the skill's duration,
you will be protected by a shield that will push back and damage
enemies that approach too closely. Doesn't that sound really useful
in heated battle situations?
scripts.translation:
[喵]
技能持续期间，会有护盾保护你，把靠近的敌人击退，并造成伤害。
打得不可开交时，很管用吧？

scripts.text: I can push enemies away?
scripts.translation: 能把敌人击退

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Sure you can, well, once you
learn the skill. Hmm, but you
need to have a good grasp on
push back theory before you can
learn the skill. Hmm, you might
need a better explanation...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
当然，学会了就能。
不过，得先弄懂击退的原理。
嗯，看来得找人仔细给你讲讲...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
You know what? Knights are
pretty much experts with skills
that push enemies back, so go
and find one who'll explain Push Back theory to you in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
骑士最擅长把敌人击退，你去普隆德拉找个骑士，请他讲讲原理。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Check the 11 o' clock
direction on your Mini-Map
in Prontera to find the Knight
Chivalry. Someone there should
be willing to teach you more
about Push Backs in skills...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
看看普隆德拉的小地图，11点钟方向就是骑士团。
那里应该有人愿意教你击退技巧...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
What are you still doing
here? Didn't I tell you to go
to the Prontera Chivalry and
ask someone there to teach
you about Push Back theory?
scripts.translation:
[喵]
怎么还在这儿？
不是叫你去普隆德拉骑士团，找人学击退原理吗？

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Hm? Oh good, you learned
the basics for pushing back
enemies. Now you're almost
ready to learn the skill that
I'm supposed to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
嗯？好，击退敌人的基本原理学会了。
这下差不多可以学我这招了。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
I'm no philanthropist, so
I expect some tuition for all
of my instruction and effort!
Mmm, what would be good for
my payment? Ah, I'm low on
enchanted stones right now~
scripts.translation:
[喵]
我又不是慈善家，费劲教你，总得收点学费！
嗯，要什么好呢？
啊，正好缺些魔法矿石~

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Go and bring me
^FF000010 Crystal Blues^000000,
^FF000010 Green Lives^000000,
^FF000010 Red Bloods^000000 and
^FF000010 Winds of Verdure^000000.

[Meow]
It's not that much,
so don't complain and
come back as soon as you
can. While you're out there,
I'm going to take another nap~
scripts.translation:
[喵]
才这么点，别抱怨，快去快回。
趁你不在，我再睡会儿~

scripts.text:
[Meow]
^333333*Yaaaaaawn~*^000000 Hm?
H-how dare you come
back without everything
I asked you for?! You
forgot what to bring,
didn't you? Grrrr...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
^333333*Yaaaaaawn~*^000000嗯？
没、没带齐，居然也敢回来？！
忘了该带什么吧？
怒吼...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
I said to bring
^ff000010 Crystal Blues^000000,
^ff000010 Green Lives^000000,
^ff000010 Red Bloods^000000 and
^ff000010 Winds of Verdure^000000!

[Meow]
Don't forget this time!
And don't even think of
waking me up until you
find everything I asked for!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
这次记牢！
东西没找齐，就别来叫醒我！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
*Yaaaawn~* Wh-wha?
Oh, it's you. So did you
bring the stones I wanted?
Mmm. Good, let me see if
you brought them all...
One, two, three...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
*Yaaaawn~*怎、怎么了？
哦，是你，矿石都带来了？
嗯，我数数...一、二、三...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
.................
Screw it. I don't feel
like counting this all.
Let me just take these,
and teach you the skill
so I can go back to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
...
算了，懒得数了。
东西我收下，赶紧教完，我还要睡觉呢。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
This skill is called,
''^FF0000Sight Blaster^000000.'' Pretty
cool, eh? Anyway, it's a Fire
attribute skill that requires
you to cast Sight before you
can activate it. Now try it.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
这招叫“^FF0000火狩芽^000000”，够酷吧？
是火属性技能，得先施展火狩，才能发动。
试试看。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
......
Huh. Not exactly right,
but not too bad for a first
try. Remember to will the
push back to happen. Ergh,
let's try it once again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[喵]
...
嗯，还不太对，不过头一回能这样，算不错了。
记得要用意念，让它产生击退效果。
唉，再试一次吧？

scripts.text:
[Meow]
You gotta will it.
Push! Push with
your freakin' mind!
Well, push the flames
you summoned with Sight
with your mind. Not that hard!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
得用意念！
推！用脑子推！
把火狩召出的火焰，用意念推出去。
又不难！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Finally...!
You actually learned it!
That took way too much effort,
but at least we're done here.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
终于...学会了！
可累死我了，总算教完。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
I'm so tired from all of
this teaching. I think I'll
take a well deserved nap
right now. Go on your way,
and if you know any Wizards,
send 'em to me, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[喵]
教得我累坏了，这觉我可得好好睡。
你走吧，认识别的巫师，也让他们来找我...大概吧。

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Zzz... Zzz...
Catherine... I'll
make you sorry for
turning me into a kitty...
I'm gonna... Gonna... Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
Zzz... Zzz...
凯瑟琳...我要让你为把我变成小猫而后悔...
我要...我要...Zzz...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
*Yaaawn~*
So sleeepy...
Hm? Did you want
to talk to me? Don't
bother me if you've
got nothing to say!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
*Yaaawn~*好困...
嗯？找我说话？
没事别烦我！

scripts.text: A cat?
scripts.translation: 猫？

scripts.text: Now I'm sleepy, too...
scripts.translation: 我也困了...

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Yeah. Yeah, I'm a cat.
For now, anyway. Damn that
Catherine! She turned me into
this form when I borrowed some
gemstones without her consent.
I was gonna tell her!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
对对，我是猫，至少现在是。
都怪那凯瑟琳！
不过是没打招呼，借了她一点宝石，就把我变成这样。
我本来就要告诉她的！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Once I become human
again and regain my powers,
I'm gonna go freakin' buck
wild. Catherine, you, everyone.
You're all turning into cats!
scripts.translation:
[喵]
等我变回人，恢复力量，就要闹个天翻地覆！
凯瑟琳、你、所有人，统统给我变成猫！

scripts.text:
[Meow]
Hah! Yeah...
Taking a nap sounds like
the best idea I've heard
all day. Hm. ^333333*Yaaawwn~*^000000
There we go, time to sleep...
ZzzzzzzZZZzzz... ZzZzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[喵]
哈，是啊...睡觉，这真是今天听到最好的主意。
嗯，^333333*Yaaawwn~*^000000好了，该睡了...
ZzzzzzzZZZzzz... 呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Ah, you must be a skilled
practitioner of magic. Mmm,
you must one of those Wizards.
High Wizards? I can't really
tell the difference. Ah, may
I be of service to you?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
啊，看你就是精通魔法的人。
嗯，是巫师？还是超魔导士？
我实在分不清。
有什么能帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I'm fine, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: I want to learn about push backs.
scripts.translation: 我想了解击退技巧

scripts.text:
[Simon]
I'm surprised that you chose
to practice magic: judging
from your build, I'd say that
you'd be well suited to wielding a sword. Haha, but that's just
a humble Knight's opinion.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
没想到你会选择学魔法，看这体格，挥剑倒是挺合适。
哈哈，不过是个普通骑士的一点看法罢了。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Wait, are you asking me
to teach you a Push-Back
attack technique? You can
defend yourself using spells
like Fire Wall or Fire Bolt
much more effectively, right?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
等等，想让我教击退技巧？
你们不是用火焰之壁、火箭术之类的魔法，更能保护自己吗？

scripts.text: But at close range...
scripts.translation: 但在近距离...

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Oh, I see. Yeah, Wizards
aren't very effective in close
range battles. Okay, I can see
why you'd want to learn some
Push-Back technique. Alright,
I can teach you a few basics.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
明白了，巫师不擅长近战，难怪你想学击退技巧。
好，我教你些基本要领。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Now, every adventurer knows
the fundamentals of attacking.
You strike, and then ready your
next action, which is either
another strike, a dodge or a
guard. Simple stuff, right?
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
攻击的基本功，冒险者都懂。
出招之后，就该准备下一步：再攻、闪避，或者防御。
很简单，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Simon]
To push an enemy back, you've
got to attack using a strike
with continuous force. It's all
in the follow through. Now, if
you strike the head, the push
distance will be too short.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
想把敌人击退，出手时就得持续发力，关键在于力道要送到底。
若打头部，击退的距离就太短了。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
If you deliver a pushing
strike to the legs, your
enemy will fall towards you.
The best target for pushing
attacks is the torso since it
allows more control of the push.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
打腿，敌人反而会朝你倒下。
最好瞄准躯干，才更容易控制击退的方向和力道。

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Well, I've explained
pushing as best as I can.
Concentrate and practice the
theory on your own, and you
should be able to do it. Good luck on your travels, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
击退的要领，我能讲的都讲了。
用心领会，再自行练习，你应该能掌握。
冒险者，祝你旅途顺利~

scripts.text:
[Simon]
Make no mistake:
swordplay is an art.
The techniques may seem
brutish at first glance, but
there's a keen strategy that
Knights innately understand.
scripts.translation:
[西蒙]
可别小瞧剑术，它是一门艺术。
看似粗犷的招式，背后也有骑士深谙的精妙战术。
